title: Choose the intended hole when several ports match
applicability: Use when a lookup by connector type reports multiple matches. The repair needs a positional or directional criterion tied to the design, in the frame of the queried part or occurrence.
steps: List the matching ports and inspect the positions and axes. On a 7229 beam there are two outer pin_hole connectors. The central axle hole has a different profile.

Resolve the hole using design intent. The example chooses the outer +Y hole of the placed beam and the +X end of the loose pin. The source's coordinates are local and the placed beam's are world coordinates.

Pass the concrete connectors to connect, then verify that the seated pin clears the beam and mates at the intended location. In a rotated assembly, compute the intended position in its new frame before applying the same rule.
expected: The unqualified target lookup raises connector.ambiguous. Using the +Y hole yields one valid connected component.
